checks: CLI system and lane discovery expose local tenant/capabilities and enforce lane scope
three concurrent principals retain separate requests and share one run; equivalent selectors/timezones and a new session replay the same task key and creation session
unlisted peer cannot withdraw/retry/raise priority; frozen collaborator withdraws only its authorized request
SIGKILL/restart permits task lookup and CLI wait on the original request; remaining peers share one verified receipt and actor audit survives
task/principal/status filtering and limit-one cursor traversal return all requests without duplicates; invalid queries are 400
client-selected tenant/principal and unknown, executor, or out-of-scope collaborators are rejected
admin can promote another owner's request; urgent retry is denied to an ordinary owner/collaborator and succeeds for admin after synthetic failure
all six persisted entity tables contain only local tenant rows and SQLite integrity is valid
